1.content: S denotes the starting cell; G denotes the goal cell that yields reward 1 upon entry; F denotes free traversable cells; H denotes impassable hazard/obstacle cells that the agent cannot occupy.

2.content: The grid layout is static: cell types (F, H, G) do not change over time, and the agent can move deterministically to any orthogonal adjacent free (F) cell.

3.content: Entering a G cell yields reward 1 and ends the episode; non-goal cells provide zero reward.

4.content: The agent has full observability of the grid at each step, receiving the complete layout of S, F, H, and G cells.
